collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE X: GROWING UP, GROWING OLD AND EVERYDAY JOY (LCJ-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
The rest of the owner's 100 Living Culture ideas and the world-inspired 50: secret languages and forgotten words, coming of age, elders who will not retire, healers' oaths, failed discoveries, masks and clothes and masterpieces nobody wanted, talent shows, ridiculous hats and the day nobody worked.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager wears clothes that feel true to who they are, and a grandparent objects: support them, or ask for a compromise.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has started wearing a wrap and shell ornaments that feel like (subject.him/her), not the clothes (subject.his/her) family always expected. (friend), (subject.his/her) grandparent, keeps asking (subject.him/her) to dress "properly" for the festival. (subject) has never felt more like (subject.him/her)self. What should happen?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) wears what feels right to the festival. (friend) is stiff all evening. At the end, (friend.he/she) admits, quietly, that (subject) looks happy, and that (friend.he/she) wants that more than anything.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) asks for a compromise. (subject) says no, kindly but firmly: this is who (subject.he/she) is. (friend) takes a long time. By the next festival, (friend.he/she) has carved (subject) a new shell ornament.
